A maintenance log printed off the Kestrel relay, posted in a plain envelope.

## The Text

```text
KESTREL RELAY / KEEPER'S LOG

TO:      DISTRICT OFFICE, HALVARD
FROM:    KEEPER ODE
SUBJECT: QUARTERLY CHECK, LATE

DAY 1   Dish two is drifting again. Re-seated the
        bearing and logged it. Third time this year.

DAY 3   Supply skiff did not come. No word why.
        Rationing the coffee, which is a crime.

DAY 4   Heard a carrier tone on the dead band at
        0300. Not ours. Not any code I know. It
        stopped when I answered it.

DAY 6   The tone came back and this time it
        answered first. It used my call sign.

DAY 7   I have shut the dish down. Send someone.
        Do not send them alone.

END OF LOG
```
